decisions.rationale: Balance of $148,053.72 covers the $144,000 down payment but leaves only about $4,050 for closing costs, which are not quantified or documented, and the $14,400 deposit is not traceable; coverage is not clearly shown.
Appraised value of $689,000 from an approved-panel appraiser does not support the $720,000 purchase price.

Recent (2026-06-01) signed letter on letterhead confirms permanent full-time employment at the stated employer; the $66,730 salary is below the stated $73,500, which affects income and ratios rather than employment status.
The credit bureau shows a $746/month Ridgeline auto loan omitted from the worksheet, which puts TDS near 50% (about 55% on documented salary), well above 44% and not marginal for DTI-03.
